cases.title: Registry identity
cases.assertion: A3-008 resolves as SYSTEM_ACTION with publishSurface SYSTEM_UI; not as TRACK.

cases.title: No standalone page
cases.assertion: Installing the package does not create a normal learning page or a new A3-008 track instance.

cases.title: Source instance required
cases.assertion: Request without a valid owned source instance is rejected.

cases.title: Server identity required
cases.assertion: Anonymous and tilda_unverified identities receive 403.

cases.title: Entitlement AND
cases.assertion: Verified identity without entitlement or MLMA_FULL product grant receives 403.

cases.title: Cross-user ownership
cases.assertion: A user cannot record an outcome for another user’s source instance.

cases.title: PUBLIC_DEMO isolation
cases.assertion: Sandbox demo creates no instance, outcome event, decision or entitlement.

cases.title: Client facts rejected
cases.assertion: Name, phone, email, message text, transcript and free text note are rejected or stripped before persistence/logging.

cases.title: Meeting validation
cases.assertion: MEETING_CONFIRMED requires meeting_at and meeting_format_code.

cases.title: Meeting routing
cases.assertion: RESULT_MEETING matches only RR2-026 and targets A3-010.

cases.title: Later permission gate
cases.assertion: LATER without explicit follow_up_permission=true is rejected and cannot route to A5-010.

cases.title: Later date gate
cases.assertion: LATER without next_action_at is rejected.

cases.title: Later routing
cases.assertion: Valid RESULT_LATER matches RR2-027 and targets A5-010.

cases.title: Refusal is final
cases.assertion: RESULT_REFUSAL matches RR2-028 and targets A5-014 without an objection-handling detour.

cases.title: No reply waits
cases.assertion: RESULT_NO_REPLY matches RR2-029 and returns WAIT_UNTIL without a destination track URL.

cases.title: Retry maximum
cases.assertion: NO_REPLY accepts retry_count 0 or 1 and rejects values above 1.

cases.title: No automatic follow-up
cases.assertion: WAIT_UNTIL creates no outbound message or scheduled contact job.

cases.title: Referral permission gate
cases.assertion: REFERRAL_WITH_PERMISSION requires referral_permission_confirmed=true.

cases.title: Referral privacy
cases.assertion: Referral PII is client-only and does not appear in server body, logs or analytics.

cases.title: Referral routing
cases.assertion: Valid RESULT_REFERRAL matches RR2-030 and targets A3-003.

cases.title: Done terminal
cases.assertion: RESULT_DONE matches RR2-031 and returns DONE with no destination URL.

cases.title: Idempotent replay
cases.assertion: Repeating the same scoped idempotency key returns the same outcome event and decision.

cases.title: Concurrent idempotency
cases.assertion: Concurrent duplicate submissions create exactly one outcome event.

cases.title: Idempotency isolation
cases.assertion: The same idempotency key under a different principal or source instance does not collide.

cases.title: Atomic decision
cases.assertion: Outcome event cannot commit without its RouteDecision.

cases.title: Correction append-only
cases.assertion: A permitted correction creates a superseding event and preserves history.

cases.title: Consumed correction blocked
cases.assertion: Correction after a downstream live instance starts returns 409 OUTCOME_ALREADY_CONSUMED.

cases.title: Paid navigation off
cases.assertion: With PAID_TRACK_NAVIGATION_ENABLED=false, a track decision is locked and destinationUrl is null.

cases.title: Draft production clamp
cases.assertion: PILOT_DRAFT_TO_TEST rules do not execute in production mode.

cases.title: Pilot rule execution
cases.assertion: In explicit non-production pilot mode, each of the six outcomes matches its intended draft rule.

cases.title: Locked design outputs
cases.assertion: TR-083 to A3-013 and TR-084 to A6-010 stay invisible locked slots.

cases.title: Inbound A3-002 adapter
cases.assertion: RR2-014 opens A3-008 after MESSAGE_SENT without preselecting the contact result.

cases.title: Inbound A2-013 adapter
cases.assertion: RR2-017 opens A3-008 after REFERRAL_REQUEST_SENT without preselecting the contact result.

cases.title: Inbound A3-003 adapter
cases.assertion: RR2-020 opens A3-008 after CALL_COMPLETED without preselecting the contact result.

cases.title: Other inbound slots remain locked
cases.assertion: A3-004, A3-005, A4-016 and A6-029 do not open A3-008 without structured rules.

cases.title: Analytics allowlist
cases.assertion: All analytics events contain only allowed coarse structured fields.

cases.title: No AI transmission
cases.assertion: A3-008 performs deterministic validation/routing and sends no facts to an AI provider.

cases.title: Production store fail closed
cases.assertion: Production without configured PostgreSQL repository returns 503 STORAGE_UNCONFIGURED.

cases.title: Graph integrity
cases.assertion: Package install does not mutate 253 effective track connections or neighboring pages.

cases.title: No production side effects
cases.assertion: No deploy, production migration, payment activation or paid-navigation activation occurs.
